en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a broad, curved street lined with trees and a park-like area. There are ornate streetlamps, cobblestone pavement, several pedestrians, and a horse-drawn carriage. Elegant townhouses or villas are partly visible behind the trees. The caption at the bottom reads "Kronenburgersingel — Nijmegen." indicating the scene is from a boulevard or ring road in Nijmegen.
